summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) end-to-end, then run a security review and code simplification pass on all phase 20 work, and manually verify the web client checkpoint with a live dev environment.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully. Security review found 2 HIGH issues (both fixed). Simplify pass eliminated duplicate HKDF derivation and double ECIES wrap. A critical bug was discovered and fixed during checkpoint verification: `fetchAndDecryptMetadata` in both `folder.service.ts` and `sdk-core` blindly JSON-parsed v2 binary blobs, causing sync failures for migrated users.

repo: The project root is `cipher-box` but phase 20 work lives in a separate `cipher-box-phase-20` directory — gsd-tools init must run from the phase directory, not the main repo.

orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` for nullable string fields in OpenAPI spec despite `type: string, nullable: true` being correct — `as unknown as string` casts are the intentional workaround, not a bug.
The recovery tool (`recovery.html`) uses intentional inline functions because it must be self-contained as an offline tool.
OTPs from Web3Auth are logged in cleartext to the API dev server stdout.
IPNS resolution produces 'Unsupported wire type 4' errors that fall back to DB cache — this is a pre-existing issue unrelated to phase 20.
Device registry format errors and bin IPNS 404s in the browser console are pre-existing noise, not phase 20 regressions.

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without checking for v2 binary format header — caused SyntaxError crash on sync for any migrated user whose vault had a v2 blob written to IPFS.
Same v2 blob handling bug as folder.service.ts — SDK fetchAndDecryptMetadata also lacked v2 format detection before JSON.parse.
Migrated-user login path (PATH A) called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs. Also had a redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair into rootIpnsKeypair.
Desktop vault init ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB storage and once for v2 blob. Reusing the first wrap eliminates the redundant operation.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 originally returned Vec<u8> with no bounds validation — changed to return Result<Vec<u8>, VaultBlobError> with key length checks to prevent silent u16 truncation.
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, which would expose encrypted key material in logs. Custom Debug impls added to redact sensitive fields.

workflow: The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug can fire after agent tool calls complete successfully — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine real success vs false failure.

When orval codegen doesn't change after modifying a NestJS DTO, check whether the OpenAPI spec actually changed — the spec may already be correct and the issue is in orval's handling of nullable types.
Security review and simplify passes are valuable to run in parallel during a checkpoint verification pause — they can be completed while waiting for user testing.
Playwright MCP can be used to drive browser login and capture console messages during manual checkpoint verification, avoiding the need to manually check the browser.

friction: gsd-tools init failed when run from the main cipher-box directory — had to detect that phase 20 lived in a sibling directory and re-run from there.
First security review attempt hit a ConnectionRefused API error and had to be re-invoked.
orval regeneration did not fix the nullable string type issue — investigation required to confirm it was a pre-existing orval bug, not a DTO problem.
Playwright MCP browser_console_messages and browser_fill_form tools required multiple ToolSearch calls to discover and use — not pre-loaded.
The v2 blob sync bug was not caught by automated tests during plan execution — it only surfaced during live manual checkpoint verification, requiring a mid-checkpoint hotfix.
open_items: M-1: Recovery tool private key not zeroed from memory after use.
M-2: No deduplication guard against concurrent lazy migration from multiple browser tabs — race condition possible.
M-3: Desktop FUSE root folder publish ECIES re-wraps the key on every publish instead of caching — optimization deferred as architectural change.
L-1: Zero-length keys are accepted by v2 blob deserializers without error.
L-2: No SRI (Subresource Integrity) hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html.
Plan 20-04 checkpoint verification (task 3 — recovery.html manual test) was in progress at end of transcript — outcome not confirmed.
